name: capabilities
title: Capabilities
purpose: How the venture works, as opposed to what it does (APQC PCF 13.1 and 13.3): one capabilities/processes/<id>.json per recurring process in the process catalog, with its owner, procedure, control points and health measures, and one capabilities/postmortems/<id>.json per blameless postmortem. The capabilities function owns it, so only the capabilities agent or a person writes these records. Never complete.
